name: git-intelligence-mcp
description: Structured local Git change and history intelligence for coding agents over MCP.

tools.name: working_tree_status
tools.description: Return bounded structured local Git working-tree status.

tools.name: local_diff
tools.description: Return bounded structured local Git changes for either the index or working tree.

discovery.note: Complete, stable tools/list is always served. This card carries a compact index (names, descriptions, risk hints) for hosts that progressively disclose model-visible definitions; tool definitions are never made connection-local or model-use-dependent.
